summary: Engine binary trusted on existence alone: no signature or hash check, symlinks followed; a same-user process can replace it in a per-user install
failure_scenario: Same-user replacement of clamscan.exe runs attacker code on every scan. Not a privilege boundary; hardening note. UNVERIFIED install location.
resolution_note: Owner sign-off 2026-11-18 (decision D7): ClamAV is not used; the engine is replaced per ADR 0004 (proposed). Finding concerns the clamscan/freshclam integration.
